info.name: disease.sh Docs - An open API for disease-related statistics COVID-19: Apple API
Get a list of supported countries for Apple mobility data

items.docs: Returns a list of supported country names

info.name: Get a list of supported subregions for specific country in the Apple mobility data set

params.name: country
params.description: A valid country name from the /v3/covid-19/apple/countries endpoint

items.docs: Returns a list of supported subregions in a country where data is available

info.name: Get COVID-19 Apple mobility data for subregions of a country

params.name: country
params.description: A valid country name from the /v3/covid-19/apple/countries endpoint

params.name: subregions
params.description: Valid subregion(s) from the /v3/covid-19/apple/countries/{country} endpoint, separated by with commas

items.docs: Returns a list of mobility data entries for subregion(s) every day since January 13th. Each entry has driving, transit, and walking data with an associated number of percentage change since January 13th
